description: This PHP source file defines the I18NMessagesController class, which handles internationalization message requests in the OrangeHRM system. It retrieves translation messages for a specific locale, manages caching via ETags, and sets appropriate HTTP headers.

classes.name: I18NMessagesController
classes.description: Controller responsible for fetching and caching internationalization messages based on locale, extending AbstractFileController and implementing PublicControllerInterface.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the service container.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the incoming HTTP request to serve translation messages for the specified locale, employing caching strategies and setting appropriate HTTP headers.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets common HTTP headers including Content-Type, cache control, and Pragma.
